transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well… I guess I’m here because I haven’t been handling things as well as I should. At the warehouse they changed my hours, and they put in this new inventory system, and ever since then I feel like I’m kind of… coming apart a bit.

I’ve missed some shifts, and I’ve even let some church commitments slip, which isn’t like me. I’ve been more short with my family than I want to be. Some mornings I get my work boots on and then just sit there, wondering if I can make myself go in. I know that probably sounds a little dramatic, but it’s been getting hard.
Do you find yourself enjoying things you used to like?

I’m not sure I’ve really paid attention to that, to be honest. I mean, I still want to enjoy things, I suppose… I just haven’t thought of it in those terms. Is that the kind of thing you mean—whether things still feel good the same way they used to?
Do things that usually bring you pleasure still feel pleasurable to you?

I… I don’t know that I can say for sure. I haven’t really been keeping track of whether things feel pleasurable or not. I guess some things still seem okay, but I may not be the best judge right now. Is that a fair answer?
Are there things that you used to enjoy doing, but now you don't enjoy them as much or at all?

I’m honestly not sure. I don’t want to say yes if I haven’t really noticed it clearly. I’ve been more focused on just getting through the day and doing what I’m supposed to do, so I haven’t paid close attention to whether I enjoy things less.

Maybe some things don’t feel quite the same, but I can’t say for certain. Is that alright to say?
Do you feel like you've lost interest in activities you used to find enjoyable?

I’m not really sure I’d call it “lost interest.” I haven’t noticed it in a clear way, I guess. I still try to do the things I normally do, but I haven’t really stopped to think about whether I’m enjoying them like before.  

Maybe I’m just not paying close enough attention… is that answering what you’re asking?
Do you feel like you're having less fun or getting less pleasure out of things than you used to?

I… I can’t really say that for sure. I haven’t noticed it clearly enough to say I’m having less fun, exactly. I’m still doing some of the usual things, but I guess I haven’t been paying much attention to whether they feel the same as they used to.

Maybe if you asked me a more specific example, I could answer better. Is that okay?
Can you think of something you usually find pleasurable that you've done recently?

Um… I’m trying to think. I guess I’ve done some ordinary things recently, like watching something on TV or having a meal I usually like, but I’m not sure I’d say I was really paying attention to whether it felt pleasurable.

I don’t want to overstate it. Nothing specific is coming to mind where I thought, “Oh, I enjoyed that.” Maybe that’s not a very helpful answer, but it’s the honest one.
Have you felt less interested in things you usually enjoy over the past two weeks?

I’m still not sure I can say that, no. I haven’t really noticed a clear drop in interest over the last two weeks. I mean, I may not be as tuned in to it as I should be, but I’m not sitting here thinking, “I don’t care about anything anymore,” if that makes sense.

Is that the kind of answer you’re looking for?
Have you experienced any feelings of pleasure in the last two weeks?

I… I think probably yes, in small ways. I don’t want to make it sound like I’m completely numb or anything. Like, maybe a decent cup of coffee or something on TV that was a little funny.

But I can’t really point to some big moment of enjoyment, if that’s what you mean. I’m not sure if that answers it the right way.
Have you lost any weight recently?

I haven’t really noticed, to be honest. My clothes don’t feel especially different or anything like that. I haven’t been weighing myself regularly, though, so I can’t say for sure. Is that okay to say?
Have you noticed any change in your appetite?

I don’t think I’ve noticed a big change, no. I mean, some days I eat a little differently, but I wouldn’t want to say my appetite has really changed if I’m not sure.

Is that a reasonable way to answer it?
Do you feel sad most of the day?

I don’t know if I’d say most of the day, exactly. I’ve had some sad moments, sure, but I don’t want to overstate it. It kind of comes and goes, I think.

Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Do you feel sad every day?

I’m not sure I’d say every day. There are days where I feel kind of low or weighed down, but I don’t know if it’s constant like that. I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is. Is that a helpful answer?
Do you feel sad nearly every day?
I’m not really sure how to answer “nearly every day.” I do have low times, but I don’t want to say yes if I’m not completely sure. It’s not like I’m keeping track, you know? Does that make sense?
Do you feel sad for most of the day, more days than not?

I’m not sure I can say that, doctor. I mean, I do get sad, but “most of the day, more days than not” sounds pretty definite, and I don’t know that I’ve been paying close enough attention to answer it that cleanly. I don’t want to say yes if that’s not quite right.
For how long have you been feeling sad?

I guess it’s been about five months now. It started around when they changed the warehouse schedule and brought in that new inventory system. I didn’t think it would bother me this much, but… yeah, that’s about when it began.
Have you been feeling anxious or on edge lately?

Yes… I mean, I wouldn’t want to overstate it, but I have been pretty on edge lately. Ever since they changed my warehouse hours and put in that new inventory system, I feel like I’m not handling things the way I should. Some mornings I’m sitting there in my work boots, just trying to get myself to go in, wondering if I can even face the place. It’s embarrassing to say.
Have you been feeling anxious most of the day?

I don’t know if I’d say most of the day, exactly… I’m trying to answer that right. But it’s been a lot. Since they changed my warehouse hours and put in that new inventory system, I just feel like I’m kind of falling apart. Some mornings I’m sitting there in my work boots thinking, “Can I even face going in?” And I hate admitting that.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience pleasure from activities that you used to enjoy?

I’m not sure I’d put it that strongly. I mean… I still try to do things I normally like, and sometimes they’re okay. Maybe I don’t get as much out of them as I used to, but I don’t know if that’s the same thing as being unable to enjoy them. Is that what you mean?
Have you lost a significant amount of weight unintentionally since your symptoms started?
I don’t think so, no. I mean, my clothes seem about the same, and nobody’s said anything. I haven’t really been keeping close track of the scale, though… should I be?
